/api/_schema is auth-gated (per-user) - call it from an authenticated page, not anon.

Table-column enum value-sets aren't in the descriptor (Prisma enums aren't parsed) - such a column renders a text input. Flow inputs DO carry their `values:`, so FlowForm renders a <select>. Relations come from runtime FK introspection.
Components own standard UI state (selection, in-flight). For bespoke layout/interaction beyond the closed component set, drop to hand-written TSX - that's the intended escape hatch.

Row values are text, never markup (another user may have written them). Every link, iframe or navigation a component builds from a value (url/file cells, Checklist fileUrl, FileField, DocViewer url, Nav/AppShell/Breadcrumbs/Dropdown href) passes the same rule as server-rendered pages: javascript:, vbscript: and non-image data: URLs become `#blocked-unsafe-url`. Login/Signup `redirect` (often a ?next= value) is honored only on this origin: a relative reference or an absolute URL on location.origin; anything else, `//host` and `\host` included, goes to `/`. StepUp checks the password through /api/_auth/token and immediately ends the session that exchange mints. MfaSetup asks for the current password before enrolling (the server requires it from a signed-in session) and shows the secret, the otpauth URI and the one-time backup codes inside [data-bm-mask]. Map marker labels are text, GanttChart colors must be hex (`#rgb`..`#rrggbbaa`, else the palette color), RichText keeps only formatting tags from its stored `value` (no attributes except a safe `<a href>`), and ExportButton prefixes a tick to text cells starting with = + - @ so they don't run as spreadsheet formulas. Modal/Drawer/Tabs/Accordion/Wizard `content` strings are still HTML: pass row values there through bm.html.
